sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.titleEn: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ViT：影像Patch與序列長度
related.titleEn: ViT: image patches and sequence length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付跨度圖、哨兵映射與可逆重建測試。；84與85長度吻合，還原序列完全相同，EOS計數單獨列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver span diagrams, sentinel mappings and reversible reconstruction tests.; Lengths84 and85 match, reconstruction is exact and EOS accounting is separate.
related.difference: 為14×14patch給列優先編號，再加分類token0；標位置編碼與patch線性投影shape。；197與50正確，patch展平往返無遺漏，分類token位置明確。
related.differenceEn: Number14×14 patches row-major, prepend class token0 and label positional and projection shapes.; Counts197 and50 match, patch roundtrip is lossless and class-token position is explicit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以每跨度一哨兵替換時，編碼器長度N−M+S；此計數不含額外EOS。；教學原100token，移除20token分4跨度；改為5跨度但移除量不變。；L=100−20+4=84；5跨度時85。
N=(H/P)(W/P)+1含分類token；非整除尺寸須另定padding或裁切。；教學224×224，P16；比較P32。；N=14²+1=197；P32時7²+1=50。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Replacing each corrupted span with one sentinel gives encoder length N−M+S, excluding extra EOS.; Teaching100 tokens with20 removed in four spans; change to five spans at fixed removed count.; L=100−20+4=84; five spans give85.
N=(H/P)(W/P)+1 includes a class token; nondivisible sizes need explicit padding or cropping.; Teaching224×224 image, P16 versus P32.; N=14²+1=197; P32 gives7²+1=50.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GCN：自迴圈與對稱正規化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付跨度圖、哨兵映射與可逆重建測試。；84與85長度吻合，還原序列完全相同，EOS計數單獨列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver span diagrams, sentinel mappings and reversible reconstruction tests.; Lengths84 and85 match, reconstruction is exact and EOS accounting is separate.
related.difference: 列A、A+I、D與正規化矩陣四張2×2表；註明度數包含自迴圈。；3與5吻合，自迴圈與度數一致，排列測試通過。
related.differenceEn: List A,A+I,D and normalized adjacency as2×2 tables; degrees include self-loops.; Values3/5 match, self-loops agree with degrees and permutation tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以每跨度一哨兵替換時，編碼器長度N−M+S；此計數不含額外EOS。；教學原100token，移除20token分4跨度；改為5跨度但移除量不變。；L=100−20+4=84；5跨度時85。
聚合矩陣D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2；兩互連節點加自迴圈後各度2，權重皆1/2。；教學節點值2與4，線性權重1、無激活；第二值改8。；y1=.5×2+.5×4=3；第二值8時y1=5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Replacing each corrupted span with one sentinel gives encoder length N−M+S, excluding extra EOS.; Teaching100 tokens with20 removed in four spans; change to five spans at fixed removed count.; L=100−20+4=84; five spans give85.

Aggregate with D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2; two linked nodes with self-loops have degree2 and weights1/2.; Teaching node values2 and4, linear weight1 and no activation; change second value to8.; y1=.5×2+.5×4=3; changing the second value to8 gives5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
